$comment: Cap Breakers in the NBA 2K series let a player raise a small number of attributes above the cap
the builder allowed, earned after launch. The count, the per-attribute limit, the eligibility
rules and whether they cost build points are ALL unknown for 2K27 and invented here.
The optimizer treats cap breakers as a POST-BUILD overlay: it optimizes the build first, then
recommends where each +1 lands by measuring which single point crosses the most valuable

verification.source: 2K27 builder coverage confirms cap breakers exist, are earned post-launch, are not viewable until the build reaches 99 overall, and do NOT grant additional badge tokens.
verification.notes: The rules below are sourced where marked. Every QUANTITY (how many, how much each raises, per-attribute limits) is still invented.

verification.source: 2K27 builder coverage: cap breaker amounts are not viewable until 99 overall, and applying them does not provide additional badge tokens.

rules.note: grantsBadgeTokens=false is why the optimizer treats cap breakers as a pure post-build overlay: a breaker can push an attribute over a badge threshold but cannot pay for the badge.

eligibility.note: mode may be 'all', 'all-except' (uses excludedAttributes) or 'only' (uses includedAttributes).
